messages:
Noah: hi all, new joiner Noah here. first-week CI hiccup: Buildkite fails when publishing the image to GHCR with a `denied` message that mentions package creation. not sure what to ask for, who to ping?

Buildkite Bot: build #9 failed: step `publish-image` (exit 1)
```
> Pushing to ghcr.io/redwood-inference/noah-playground:pr-4
> denied: write access to the repository is required to create a package
> failed to push some refs to 'ghcr.io/redwood-inference/noah-playground'
```

Noah: i ran the local docker login test and got the same error even though the PAT has `write:packages` scope: 
```
echo "$MY_PAT" | docker login ghcr.io -u noah --password-stdin
docker push ghcr.io/redwood-inference/noah-playground:canary
# -> denied: write access to the repository is required to create a package
```

Maya: welcome! :wave: that error usually means GHCR attempted to create the package namespace under the org but org settings block package creation by non-admins. some orgs require an admin to pre-create package entries or to allow members/apps to publish packages. do you know if your account is SSO-approved and the PAT scoped correctly?

Noah: PAT scopes are correct and SSO is approved. i think this is an org policy thing because i can push to my personal namespace but not to `redwood-inference/*`.

Rafi: yep this is a thing we've seen. GitHub has org-level package publishing controls. ops historically turned off "Allow members to publish packages" for the org to prevent accidental package pollution. options: (1) ops can pre-create the package under the org and assign write permission, (2) an admin can temporarily enable member package publishing, or (3) you can push to a personal namespace for testing.

Noah: option 1 sounds fine. how does ops pre-create the package?

Ops: i can create the package placeholder for you. i need the exact image name you want created (ghcr will map to a package). i'll make `ghcr.io/redwood-inference/noah-playground` and grant the CI service account publish rights. ping me when you're ready.

Noah: thanks — creating it now would be amazing. i'm ready.

Ops: done. i created the package `noah-playground` in the org and granted the CI service principal write access. also added a short note in the onboarding doc about org package controls. try your local push or re-run Buildkite.

Noah: re-ran the local push and now it succeeds: 
```
echo "$MY_PAT" | docker login ghcr.io -u noah --password-stdin
docker push ghcr.io/redwood-inference/noah-playground:canary
# -> pushed: ghcr.io/redwood-inference/noah-playground:canary
```

Buildkite Bot: build #10 started — step `publish-image`

Buildkite Bot: build #10 succeeded :tada: image pushed to ghcr.io/redwood-inference/noah-playground:pr-4

Noah: great, all green! adding a note to onboarding: "If you see an error about package creation even with `write:packages`, check org package publishing policy — ops may need to pre-create the package or enable member publishing." thanks @Ops and @Maya for the assist. :smile:
